title: Review Result
description: Output payload of the tpu-critical-review agent, for a claim or a stop. `pass` is what the caller routes on; the verdict, the fix list and, for a stop, the continuations say why. The full review stays on disk in `report_artifact`.

status.description: 'reviewed': the review reached a verdict, including UNVERIFIABLE. 'invalid_input': the request names no claim or no artifact; every gap is listed in `missing`. 'failed': the review could not run. The fields each status owes are declared in `status_requires`.

summary.description: The verdict and the one finding that decided it.

verdict.description: kind claim: CONFIRMED / PARTIALLY CONFIRMED / REFUTED / UNVERIFIABLE for a document, ESTABLISHED / PLAUSIBLE-UNCONFIRMED / NOT SUPPORTED for an A/B result. kind stop: EXIT JUSTIFIED / EXIT PREMATURE / EXIT MISCLASSIFIED / UNVERIFIABLE.

pass.description: kind claim: true only for CONFIRMED or ESTABLISHED, when the claim may be reported as stated. kind stop: true only for EXIT JUSTIFIED, when the stop stands.

fixes.description: The fix list: findings ranked most severe first.

finding.description: What is claimed, what is the case, and the consequence if uncorrected.

termination_class.description: kind stop only: the class the stop claimed and the one the evidence supports. They differ on EXIT MISCLASSIFIED.

continuations.description: kind stop only, so it requires `termination_class`: at most three priced continuations, ranked. Empty when none survives pricing.

owner.description: The agent or procedure that owns it.

cost.description: TPU jobs and servers it would launch.

expected_value.description: Ceiling in ms/step or percent, times a stated rough probability.

drop_if.description: The cheap observation that kills it first.

report_artifact.description: Path of the full review: reproduction table, findings, strongest cases, what survives, what could not be checked.

missing.description: Inputs the caller must add, when status is 'invalid_input'.

run_id.description: Identifier of the active TPU agent suite run namespace.

examples.summary: NOT SUPPORTED: recomputed delta is -3.9%, not -8.1%; the candidate arm read back a different max-num-batched-tokens.

fixes.finding: Arms ran different shapes: recipe.yaml read-back shows mnbt 8192 vs 4096, so the delta is not the flag's.

examples.summary: EXIT PREMATURE: the floor divides by HBM bandwidth but the op is MXU bound; the recomputed floor is 0.21 ms against 0.48 ms measured.

continuations.brief: Remove the D_rope 64->256 contraction padding in QK Rope at decode-b64.
continuations.drop_if: a padded-vs-unpadded microbench shows under 0.05 ms

examples.summary: No artifact to recompute the claim from.

missing.reason: A review recomputes from raw sources; none was given.
